title: Massachusetts And Federal Registration
rule_summary: Massachusetts practitioners conducting approved Schedule II-V controlled-substance activities generally require both Massachusetts Controlled Substances Registration and corresponding DEA registration, while approved Schedule VI-only activity requires the appropriate Massachusetts registration but not a federal DEA registration solely because of Schedule VI status.
exam_relevance: Tests a distinct pharmacist decision path using current official authority rather than rote trivia.
verification_notes: Authoring-session current official-source verification on 2026-08-14; requires fresh independent audit before release.
